text_930f72ca057f: The Android APK includes the complete reference catalogue with 13,720 DS100 entries and 5,408 verified GPS coordinates. No initial catalogue download is needed. Search codes and names and select locations for departure, destination and stops while offline. Entries without coordinates remain searchable. Stop-location suggestions run locally without a connection. When online, the app downloads the complete current server catalogue and stores it locally; it refreshes on opening when the saved snapshot is at least one day old. The five frequent places are stored separately for each driver and offered offline from the last available snapshot. In a browser, first open the portal online and keep the page open for offline work. A local catalogue snapshot is retained in browser storage. Check automatic suggestions and change them if needed. Map tiles still need an internet connection.
text_567c583f72ff: Complete Android offline DS100 catalogue: 13,720 entries, 5,408 coordinates, local station search and stop suggestions, and driver-scoped cached frequent places.
